bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to campaign finance; modifying the definition of administrative action as it applies to the Public Utilities Commission; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 10A.01, subdivision 2.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 10A.01, subdivision 2, is amended to read:

Subd. 2.
Administrative action.
[+(a) +]"Administrative action" means an action by any official, board, commission or agency of the executive branch to adopt, amend, or repeal a rule under chapter 14. [-"-]Administrative action[-"-] does not include the application or administration of an adopted rule[-, except in cases of rate setting, power plant and powerline siting, and granting of certificates of need under section 216B.243-].

[+(b) Notwithstanding paragraph (a), administrative action includes the exercise of any power or duty given to the Public Utilities Commission under statute or adopted rule. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to campaign finance; modifying the definition of administrative action as it applies to the Public Utilities Commission; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 10A.01, subdivision 2.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 10A.01, subdivision 2, is amended to read:

Subd. 2.
Administrative action.
(a) "Administrative action" means an action by any official, board, commission or agency of the executive branch to adopt, amend, or repeal a rule under chapter 14. Administrative action does not include the application or administration of an adopted rule.

(b) Notwithstanding paragraph (a), administrative action includes the exercise of any power or duty given to the Public Utilities Commission under statute or adopted rule.
additions: (b) Notwithstanding paragraph (a), administrative action includes the exercise of any power or duty given to the Public Utilities Commission under statute or adopted rule.
deletions: , except in cases of rate setting, power plant and powerline siting, and granting of certificates of need under section 216B.243
